questions.question: Which sentence uses the Present Perfect correctly?
questions.explanation: Present Perfect uses have/has + past participle for past experiences.

questions.question: In English, adjectives usually come before the noun they modify.
questions.explanation: In English, adjectives typically precede the noun they describe.

questions.question: She ___ (study) English for five years now.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect Continuous shows an action ongoing from past to present.

questions.question: What is the difference between active and passive voice?
questions.answer: Active voice: subject performs action (He wrote the letter). Passive voice: subject receives action (The letter was written).
questions.explanation: Voice indicates the relationship between subject and verb action.
